title: AgentCore payments
hook: Agents that can pay: secure micropayments to paid APIs and services without per-vendor billing code.

back.lead: AgentCore payments lets agents make secure, instant micropayments ({{slot:transaction_size}}) to paid data providers and services, using Coinbase CDP or Stripe Privy Wallet — without integrating each vendor's payment stack.

kv.v: Research agents buying per-call access to premium data (market data, filings, specialist APIs) mid-task.
Unlocks the 'agentic economy' pattern: tools that charge per use become directly consumable by autonomous agents.

back.hookline: Identity answered 'as whom?'; payments answers 'and who's paying?' — the last blocker for fully autonomous workflows.

history.reason: Card claimed transactions are "typically $0.10–$3.00 per call". No AWS source carries that range, and the AgentCore payments documentation contradicts its upper bound: "Transactions are typically microtransactions (often under $1 or fractions of a cent)". Replaced with the documented characterisation.
